## This week ...

Sometimes, embarrassing is good. Like when a task is embarrassingly parallel.

## Required Reading

- Charlie Gao, Hadley Wickham, Davis Vaughan, and Lionel Henry. 2025. "[Parallel processing in purrr 1.1.0](https://tidyverse.org/blog/2025/07/purrr-1-1-0-parallel/)." _Tidyverse Blog_, July 10.

This post introduces `in_parallel()`, the new way of running `purrr`'s `map()` functions in parallel, using `mirai` as the back end. It's what we'll use in class.
